verdict.rationale: Logseq's first-party docs describe an official Logseq Sync service that syncs up to 10 graphs between Desktop, Android and iOS, and state that the graph is end-to-end encrypted. Community reports confirm it exists but call it buggy and in testing (sponsor-gated), and one says early sync attempts didn't work well. These are reliability caveats rather than a concrete contradiction of the claim. Missing for 10: detail on the encryption and key model proving the vendor can't read notes, independent confirmation that sync is stable and production-ready, and evidence of reliability across devices beyond beta-era reports.
